commit 7a9fe8103c31b500dbb68f9db7ecc76a5fca5651
Author: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@example.com>
Date:   Thu Jun 19 10:03:33 2025 -0700

    feat(signal): make the default deduplication window configurable
    
    The window applied to signals without a deduplication filter was
    hard-coded. It is now read from SIGNAL_DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES.

diff --git a/src/dispatch/config.py b/src/dispatch/config.py
index 754ae727..38570e56 100644
--- a/src/dispatch/config.py
+++ b/src/dispatch/config.py
@@ -90,6 +90,11 @@ ENV_TAG_LIST = config("ENV_TAGS", cast=CommaSeparatedStrings, default="")
 ENV_TAGS = get_env_tags(ENV_TAG_LIST)
 
 DISPATCH_UI_URL = config("DISPATCH_UI_URL", default="http://localhost:8080")
+
+# signals
+SIGNAL_DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES = config(
+    "SIGNAL_DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES", cast=int, default=45
+)
 DISPATCH_ENCRYPTION_KEY = config("DISPATCH_ENCRYPTION_KEY", cast=Secret)
 
 # authentication
diff --git a/src/dispatch/signal/service.py b/src/dispatch/signal/service.py
index 2ac5c55c..31ec084e 100644
--- a/src/dispatch/signal/service.py
+++ b/src/dispatch/signal/service.py
@@ -16,6 +16,7 @@ from dispatch.case.models import Case
 from dispatch.case.priority import service as case_priority_service
 from dispatch.case.type import service as case_type_service
 from dispatch.case.type.models import CaseType
+from dispatch.config import SIGNAL_DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES
 from dispatch.database.service import apply_filter_specific_joins, apply_filters
 from dispatch.entity.models import Entity
 from dispatch.entity_type import service as entity_type_service
@@ -807,7 +808,9 @@ def filter_dedup(*, db_session: Session, signal_instance: SignalInstance) -> Sig
         return signal_instance
 
     if not signal_instance.signal.filters:
-        default_dedup_window = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=1)
+        default_dedup_window = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(
+            minutes=SIGNAL_DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES
+        )
         instance = (
             db_session.query(SignalInstance)
             .filter(
            signal_instance.filter_action = SignalFilterAction.deduplicate
            break

    return signal_instance


def filter_signal(*, db_session: Session, signal_instance: SignalInstance) -> bool:
    """
    Apply filter actions to the signal instance.

    The function first checks if the signal instance is snoozed. If not snoozed,
    it checks for a deduplication rule set on the signal instance. If no
    deduplication rule is set, a default deduplication rule is applied,
    grouping all signal instances together for a 1-hour window, regardless of
    the entities in the signal instance.

    Args:
        db_session (Session): Database session.
        signal_instance (SignalInstance): Signal instance to be filtered.

    Returns:
        bool: True if the signal instance is filtered, False otherwise.
    """
    filtered = False

    signal_instance = filter_snooze(db_session=db_session, signal_instance=signal_instance)

    # we only dedupe if we haven't been snoozed
    if not signal_instance.filter_action:
        signal_instance = filter_dedup(db_session=db_session, signal_instance=signal_instance)

content.text:
The commit is 7a9fe810, "feat(signal): make the default deduplication window configurable". Before it, the window for signals with no filter was hard-coded as `timedelta(hours=1)` in `filter_dedup` in `src/dispatch/signal/service.py`. The commit replaced that with the setting `SIGNAL_DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES`, which has a default of 45 minutes. That setting is defined in `src/dispatch/config.py`.

I didn't look at any other commits that touched this code. A later commit, 9dc24f46, only refactored the lookback computation. The `filter_signal` docstring still says "1-hour window", which is out of date.

COMMIT: 7a9fe8103c31b500dbb68f9db7ecc76a5fca5651
AUTHOR: Jordan Lee
DATE: 2025-06-19
PREVIOUS_VALUE: 1 hour
